alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a door at the right and a low bench at the left. A ink-black block figure with white eyes and a flat red crown leans its forehead against the closed door and strains; a royal-blue figure sits on the bench and watches. The door swings open by itself, the black figure steps in with its crown held high and happy eyes, steps back out, the door closes, and it leans on the door again, exactly as at the start. White subtitles at the bottom read: She has no hands. She will not ask. Day 400. She has no hands.
